about: DEER quota hunts only (guide rows 1-38). Closed = the area's own page says it is closed to everyone except drawn hunters. Note = hunt dates only. Dates read twice from the guide (two reads agree on all 38 rows; the reader paraphrases notes). Not in the guide's deer table: pheasant, waterfowl, elk, fox-trial hunts (area pages already feed those). State park hunts: inside_park NOT VERIFIED = held back until the hunt map is checked against the POTA boundary.
